title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences for your account and the app.

menuPosition.title: Menu position
menuPosition.desc: Navigation bar at the top or on the left side.

motion.title: Motion
motion.desc: Animates transitions and scroll effects. Reducing makes navigation more direct, independent of your system setting.

a11yWidget.title: Accessibility widget
a11yWidget.desc: Floating button in the bottom-right corner with text size, link underlining, reduced motion and Libras (Brazilian Sign Language). Applies to this device.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Interface language. Follows your account on any device.

chart.title: Default dashboard chart
chart.desc: Initial style of the "Revenue vs. Expenses" chart.
